input_policy: Byte-identical original state/question/options per sample, all 30 fields and 283 candidates.
batch_policy: Independent samples from ONE AC task; native sample boundaries/masks; no joint-question substitution.
screen_order: Rotate variant order per case; warm all layouts once; external tasks and models serial.
screen_acceptance: No errors or newly wrong complete commands on pilot; >=10% mean latency reduction vs matching layout.
selection: Fastest passing batch size per model; transfer compared separately against native full30.
confirmation: 156 quality cases (78 queries x both option orders) in each selected and matching original layout; 20 original spec queries x3 repetitions, interleaved; all cases newly executed.
confirmation_gate: No baseline-correct case becomes incorrect; accuracy/extra/missing commands do not worsen per dataset/order; mean >=10% faster and p95 no worse. Repeat after service restart.
repeatability: Ten pilot cases plus all observed choice differences, each variant repeated three times after restart.
single_step: Actual calls in the serial30 performance blocks; not batch wall divided by thirty.
not_claimed: Finite tests cannot prove no regression on every unseen input.
precision: Existing BF16 weights and attention; no quantization/causal changes.
